summary.scope: 20 cultivar references and 15 previously unresolved names
summary.policy: Catalog and recognition operate at species level only. No cultivar entities, product fields, UI, or training classes. Original names survive only as source provenance. Use existing stable species IDs; do not merge distinct species or replace a hybrid with an arbitrary parent. Links are not universal synonyms or automatic image-training labels; hidden/missing Chinese rows remain unchanged.
